world_org_meetings.title: Actors Susan Sarandon, Hannah Einbinder among detained protestors outside Netanyahu's UN speech
world_org_meetings.description: Actors Susan Sarandon and Hannah Einbinder were among the protestors detained in New York City on Thursday as Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivered a speech to the United Nations General Assembly.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelenskyy addresses UN as Rubio of U.S. says Ukraine, Russia have interest in limited ceasefire
world_org_meetings.description: Russia pounded Kyiv with drone strikes on Wednesday, hitting railway infrastructure, warehouses and fuel stations, just hours before Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addressed the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

world_org_meetings.title: Syrian leader lashes out at Israel in UN speech, says Golan is inseparable part of Syria
world_org_meetings.description: Syria's leader has lashed out at Israel in a speech to the United Nations General Assembly

world_org_meetings.title: Tensions between India and Bangladesh are in focus after Dhaka skipped the BRICS summit in Delhi
world_org_meetings.description: Bangladesh's absence from the BRICS summit in New Delhi has raised fresh questions about strained ties. Ousted PM Sheikh Hasina's exile in India remains a major obstacle to normalizing relations.

world_org_meetings.title: Trump invites Putin to Miami G20: Why that matters
world_org_meetings.description: US Secretary of State Rubio said the summit would be an 'opportunity' for Putin to engage with other world leaders.

diplomatic_visits.title: Watch: Why has Trump been so eager to welcome Xi?
diplomatic_visits.description: President Donald Trump has been talking about Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit for months, the BBC's Sarah Smith looks at why.

diplomatic_visits.title: Trump greets Xi on tarmac as Chinese leader arrives for state visit
diplomatic_visits.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on Wednesday, where he was met with a rare planeside greeting from U.S. President Donald Trump after their top officials agreed to extend a trade truce until January.

diplomatic_visits.title: The future of AI in their hands? Trump-Xi summit dismisses calls for global oversight
diplomatic_visits.description: It’s their AI world and we’re just living in it. If that's the feeling of those who suffer from AI anxiety, it may worsen watching the Chinese president’s first state visit to Washington in nine years. If there's one issue where the planet's biggest superpowers agree on, it's now’s not the time for global regulation of artificial intelligence. As they sit down to a White House dinner hours after news that OpenAI had hacked the Australian government, we’ll ask who will call to task the US tech titans at the table.

diplomatic_visits.title: Taiwan: Home of semiconductor giants at the centre of AI race
diplomatic_visits.description: The topic of artificial intelligence looms large as Chinese President Xi Jinping begins his highly anticipated state visit to Washington. The fate of Taiwan – coveted by its larger neighbour, China – will also be on the table. It's the global leader in superconductor research and development. These powerful chips can be found in smartphones, computers, and above all in AI development. Our France 2 colleagues take a rare look inside one of Taiwan's state-of-the-art laboratories.

diplomatic_visits.title: Why is Trump rolling out the red carpet for China's Xi?
diplomatic_visits.description: US President Donald Trump will host Chinese leader Xi Jinping at the White House on Thursday for a day full of pageantry. Trump personally greeted Xi on the tarmac after his arrival on Wednesday, the first time in more than six decades that a US president has welcomed a foreign political leader at Joint Base Andrews near Washington. But Trump's decision to roll out the red carpet has ruffled feathers among both Democrats and Republicans.

elections.title: International watchdog calls for protection of journalists ahead of Serbia election
elections.description: An international media watchdog says that journalists in Serbia are increasingly under threat of violence and hostility ahead of a high-stakes early parliamentary election that will test populist President Aleksandar Vucic’s rule

elections.title: Russia's parliamentary election result underscores public support for Kremlin policies, Putin says
elections.description: President Vladimir Putin says Russia’s first wartime parliamentary election, which further strengthened the Kremlin’s already-overwhelming legislative control, was a sign of public support for his policies

elections.title: Morocco votes for new parliament amid hopes and concerns over cost of living
elections.description: Hopes and concerns over jobs, wages, public services and cost of living dominate Morocco’s parliamentary election as the country prepares for the 2030 World Cup.

elections.title: Gaza watches Israel’s elections with fear and antipathy
elections.description: Palestinians are following the campaign, but few feel next month's vote will make their lives any better.

elections.title: Dems have an edge over GOP, poll finds. And, ICE looks into 'mobile detention centers'
elections.description: An NPR poll shows that Democrats have an edge over Republicans going into the midterms, partially due to Trump. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement is looking into "mobile detention centers."
